issues.description: The type of the 'birthday' attribute is inconsistent between template, solution, and tests. In the template Person.java the 'birthday' field is declared as java.time.LocalDate, and the tests (PersonServiceTest and PersonIntegrationTest) set and expect LocalDate values. However, the solution repository's Person.java declares the 'birthday' field as String while its getter and setter use LocalDate, producing a structural type mismatch that will prevent compilation and confuses the intended design (birthday should be a LocalDate).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the 'birthday' attribute type consistent across all artifacts. Change the declaration in the solution's Person.java to 'private LocalDate birthday;' and ensure the getter and setter use LocalDate. Update equals/hashCode and any serialization configuration if necessary so tests and template code compile and behave consistently.
